Year -to-date In Q4 25, shrimp feed sales shrimp feed sales remained high at THB 
1,115mn, increasing 21.4% YoY. The increase was mainly driven by 
significant volume growth of 20.5% YoY , supported by the following: 
• Thailand: strong domestic demand across all regions and higher export 
shipments, together rising  26.0% YoY
• Indonesia: Shrimp feed sales declined by 3.8% YoY due to radiation -
related industry disruptions that pressured shrimp prices, despite early 
signs of recovery from previous disease challenges.
• GPM surged to 24.4%, up 2.5 ppts YoY , driven mainly by higher sales 
volume and lower soybean meal prices.

Year -to-dateIn Q4 25, Fish feed sales rose by 6.7% YoY , mainly driven by higher 
volume of seabass (+26.1% YoY). This growth reflects continued market 
share expansion, reinforcing the company’s position as the market leader 
in seabass feed. Other fish feed categories declined by 11.2% YoY due to a 
gourami disease outbreak, credit concerns in certain regions, and 
intensified competition.
GPM also improved by 0.7% YoY to 20.4% in Q4 25 , supported by lower 
soybean meal prices and a high proportion of seabass in the product mix.

the strategic shift toward profitable SKUs implemented in 2H FY24.
